context-01.translation: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

corpus-03.translation: Not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

name-01.translation: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

corpus-02.translation: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lines!

corpus-01.translation: Teacher, I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.

slang-01.translation: That move was way too slick—I'm literally losing it.

corpus-09.translation: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-06.translation: Seems like it's true—I even came across some fan-shot videos from his concert.

corpus-05.translation: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Like, who even gets this question?

errors.note: “太抽象了”指内容荒诞、难以理解，译成“so random”改变了意思，偏向“随意、无厘头”，与原意有明显偏差。

corpus-10.translation: That idea of yours is seriously out there.

corpus-07.translation: Which class meeting? How come nobody told me?

errors.note: 原文“我怎么没听着”是说话人自己没听到/没收到通知，译文改成“没人告诉我”，把“自己没听到”变成“别人没通知我”，主体和含义都发生了偏移。

corpus-08.translation: Besides, his honest, down-to-earth vibe makes him so approachable. You're not losing out this time—you might even mooch a free meal with that face.

corpus-12.translation: That short? Hit a creative block?

corpus-11.translation: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap when I get back to China.

corpus-15.translation: Just look at that fake-deep expression on his face—you know something's up. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-16.translation: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you're always posting sunrises on Moments.

corpus-14.translation: Your proposal vs. your coworker's PPT — who wins?

corpus-21.translation: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole time.

corpus-18.translation: Not happening. Go play by yourself.

corpus-19.translation: Look, the numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

errors.note: “Look”作为引起注意的感叹语略显生硬，口语字幕中更自然的说法是“Hey”或直接省略。
原文“你昨天说的”指你说的号码，译文“what you said”未明确是号码，略有歧义，但整体可理解。

corpus-17.translation: Not dating. These days, love comes with a price tag.

errors.note: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，译成“Not dating”意思接近但语气和语境偏差，且原文“不处”更像拒绝或感叹，译文显得生硬直译。
作为字幕口语，“Not dating”不够自然，缺少原文那种口语感叹语气。

corpus-20.translation: Hakimi north-south mung beans—I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.

errors.note: “哈基米”是网络梗（源自日语“はちみ”/蜂蜜，常指可爱小动物），并非人名 Hakimi，音译成专有人名会误导观众。
“南北绿豆”是配合“哈基米”的无意义押韵梗，直译成 north-south mung beans 让英文观众完全无法理解，属误译/生硬直译。

errors.span: I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk
errors.note: “憋出内伤”强调忍笑到内伤，译文意思基本对但偏解释性、不够口语化，可更贴近字幕口语。

corpus-28.translation: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.

corpus-22.translation: Stayed up late last night watching your livestream—laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-27.translation: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-23.translation: Was in such a hurry to leave that I grabbed the rag and took it to work, thinking it was my towel.

corpus-29.translation: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better suited for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-24.translation: Not dating. This drama's too big to even process.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，译成“Not dating”虽方向对，但原文“不处”在此语境更可能是“不处了/不处对象”的省略，需结合语境；若指“不处（不相处）”，则“Not dating”属误译，会误导观众。
“瓜”指八卦/爆料，“啃不动”指信息量太大难以消化，译文“too big to even process”基本传达，但“drama”偏指戏剧性事件而非“瓜（八卦）”，语义有偏差。

errors.span: This drama's too big to even process.
errors.note: “too big to even process”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法如“too much to take in”，但不影响理解。

corpus-32.translation: I'm already running a fever—please, ladies, just leave me alone.

corpus-31.translation: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who hasn't had an embarrassing sanitary pad shopping story!

errors.note: “大家”是泛指的“everyone/you all”，译成“Come on”是祈使语气，改变了原句的陈述语气。
“买卫生巾的社死故事”译得偏生硬、书面，字幕口语中更自然说法如“period pad shopping horror story”或“embarrassing pad-buying story”。

corpus-34.translation: I keep getting interrupted by messages at work and can't stay focused. Any tips on how to be more productive?

corpus-33.translation: Watch Gen Z chat in internet slang

errors.note: “00后”指2000年后出生的一代，译为“Gen Z”不准确，后者通常指1990年代中至2010年代初出生者，代际范围有偏差。

corpus-38.translation: I was scrolling through videos and saw this huge jianbing guozi from a Shandong auntie's stall—now I'm suddenly wondering, is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the whole country?

corpus-39.translation: Its 9.4 rating on Douban proves just how good it is.

corpus-40.translation: I can't handle this—the happiness came out of nowhere!

corpus-42.translation: Hahaha I'm dying, netizens these days are just too creative

corpus-45.translation: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called that... Xiaochao Team, right? I remember it all!

corpus-47.translation: Can you stop dragging me into playing games?

errors.note: “drag someone into doing”偏书面/生硬，口语字幕用“dragging me to play games”或“making me play games”更自然。

corpus-41.translation: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Chocliz ice cream bar.

errors.note: “吊睛白额虎”是《水浒传》中老虎的固定称谓，指眼睛上吊、额头有白斑的猛虎；译成“white-browed”（白眉）把“白额”（白额头）误译成了白眉毛，属轻微偏差。
“巧乐兹”是伊利旗下雪糕品牌，通常音译为“Chocliz”尚可，但“a Chocliz ice cream bar”读起来像泛指某品牌雪糕，品牌专名处理略显生硬，建议保留品牌名并加注。

ctx-01.translation: Don't worry, I've already memorized it.

corpus-44.translation: I'm done—I've worked so much overtime I'm completely numb.

corpus-49.translation: I can't do this anymore. I know everything—I've grinded so hard I'm going bald.

corpus-48.translation: I can't even—this is way too cute!

ctx-02.translation: She said she won't be home for dinner tonight.

ctx-c02.translation: Keep it dry, or you'll have to change into a new pair again.

ctx-c05.translation: The power of six wallets—her family must be loaded, right?

m-002.translation: I'd suggest taking your parents to a physical store to try out how smoothly the system runs. For the memory, go with the 12GB RAM + 256GB storage version.

m-001.translation: Psst, just search "主理人" on Douyin and raise an e-pet to get your fix.

errors.note: 专有名词/搜索关键词未翻译，英文字幕观众无法照着搜索，应给出英文对应或音译。

errors.span: raise an e-pet to get your fix
errors.note: “过过瘾”译为 get your fix 略有增译，但基本传达意思，属轻微偏差。

m-003.translation: Excuse me, did you just crawl out of the starter zone?

m-005.translation: Seeing a little dog by the roadside wagging its tail at me

ctx-c57.translation: LMAO, you should've added a little more to that last line—you got the boss completely worked up. When us socially anxious folks snap, we really go hard.

errors.span: you should've added a little more to that last line
errors.note: 原文“最后那句加点啊”是建议/感叹语气，译文用“you should've”略显指令性，但基本意思保留，属轻微语气偏差。
原文“社恐人”是网络口语，译文“socially anxious folks”偏书面/正式，字幕口语感稍弱，但不影响理解。

ctx-c38.translation: Sometimes his touch is just insane—the crowd starts suspecting he's using cheats, and the comments flood with "666" until they can't even be bothered to boo.

errors.note: “comments”指评论，但原文“刷屏”指弹幕/聊天刷屏，用“the chat floods”或“the screen floods”更贴合字幕语境。

errors.span: until they can't even be bothered to boo
errors.note: “until”暗示观众先刷666、之后才懒得嘘，原文是并列关系（既刷666又懒得嘘），逻辑略有偏差。

m-004.translation: Some people always love quoting movie lines when playing poker.

m-006.translation: Guess what? Our school cafeteria was free today!

errors.note: 原文“今天居然免费”指今天这一餐/活动免费，用过去时“was free”易被理解为食堂（本身）过去是免费的，时态与语义有偏差。

m-007.translation: Hahahaha I can picture it so vividly.

m-012.translation: I have to get through this document today.

m-011.translation: I just found out my mom gave away my prized figurine collection.

m-008.translation: I'm not obligated to tell you—it's my little secret.

m-009.translation: Can you become a pro just by shitposting? Are you the plagiarism police or something?

m-013.translation: Some people say I look really white, like I'm mixed-race.

m-010.translation: Lately I've noticed a lot of my friends are into stand-up comedy—even my parents have started watching it.

m-014.translation: Last night while gaming, I just found out that long-pressing this key unleashes your ultimate.

m-015.translation: Bestie, I can't even—this gossip is too juicy.

m-016.translation: Remember to bring a big lightweight cloth bag for all your stuff—a backpack's not convenient on the beach.

m-017.translation: This streamer's story is absolutely insane.

m-019.translation: I really can't take it anymore—my stomach's about to explode.

m-018.translation: This game is way too hard, it's ridiculous!

m-022.translation: Li Zongheng's performance here is absolutely incredible—he could easily make it onto the big stage.

m-020.translation: And that whole "so what, what can you do" thing—listening to it makes me want to crap. It's as brainwashing as a virus.

errors.span: so what, what can you do
errors.note: “那咋了又能怎”是口语化的“那又怎样/你能怎么办”，译文拆成“so what, what can you do”改变了原意，且“what can you do”更像“你能做什么”，不是“又能怎”的无奈语气。
“洗脑程度堪比病毒”是比喻病毒式传播/洗脑，译文“as brainwashing as a virus”生硬且搭配不自然，英语中通常说“as catchy/addictive as a virus”之类。

m-024.translation: Everyone here must be crying from the stress by now!

errors.span: must be crying from the stress
errors.note: “急哭”指因焦急/着急而哭，译文改成“因压力而哭”，改变了情绪原因，意思有偏差。
“在座的各位”是直接称呼观众的口语表达，译成“Everyone here”变成第三人称陈述，语气不够自然。

m-027.translation: What do you guys even mean by "yes-man"?

m-026.translation: So now every time I just tell him, "Then deal with it," and let him get a taste of what it's like to suffer in silence.

m-023.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? I'm going to make up the lesson right now.

errors.note: “我去”是轻微感叹，译成“Damn”语气偏重、偏粗，与原文口语感叹程度不完全对应。
“补课”指补上落下的课，用“make up the lesson”略显生硬，更自然说法如“make up the class”或“catch up on the lesson”。

m-029.translation: You made me waste so much time.

m-025.translation: Starting the tutorial at frame zero, seriously? Not even a warm-up—did this coach switch over from esports or something?

errors.span: Starting the tutorial at frame zero
errors.note: “0帧教学”指教学从第0帧/一开局就开始，译文“at frame zero”字面直译，英语观众难以理解其“一上来就开教”的含义，意思传达有偏差。
原文“可还行”是调侃式反问，译文用“seriously?”语气偏质问，口语调侃感略弱，但可接受。

m-031.translation: Haven't you noticed he always spins around on the red carpet at every big event?

m-032.translation: I've noticed this guy keeps leaving marks on my water bottle lately.

m-035.translation: The PPT the teacher put up in class was hilarious.

m-034.translation: I can't stand this group anymore.

errors.note: “这群”指这群人/这个地方的这群人，译成“this group”偏向“这个团体/小组”，意思有偏差，应译为“these people”或“this crowd”。

errors.span: I can't stand this group anymore.
errors.note: 原文“没法待了”是口语化的“待不下去”，译文语气偏书面，字幕口语感不足。

m-036.translation: When I watch funny videos, I hold back my laughter and don't dare laugh out loud.

m-037.translation: Let me show you all a little trick.

m-033.translation: Bro B reenacts that classic student moment of paying attention in class when suddenly, out of nowhere, you just get mad

errors.note: “b哥”是网络昵称，译作“Bro B”略显生硬，但可接受；不算严重错误。
原文“一股无名火”指突然涌起的莫名怒火，译文“get mad”稍弱，但基本达意。

m-039.translation: I heard Nestlé's making an indie film.

m-041.translation: That's so random—what kind of new tactic is this?

m-038.translation: I'd suggest you go through all of them—after all, last year's test takers said a question 'definitely won't be on the exam,' and it still showed up.

m-040.translation: I can't even—this looks way too much like it.

errors.note: “I can't even—”是网络流行语，语气偏轻佻，与原文“我不行了”表达惊叹/受不了的语气不完全对应，略显不自然。

errors.span: this looks way too much like it
errors.note: 原文“这也太像了吧”指某物与另一物相似，译文“looks way too much like it”基本达意，但“it”指代不明，且“looks like”偏视觉，原文“像”范围更广。

m-045.translation: I can't take this anymore. Waking people up in the middle of the night is just too much.

m-044.translation: This is way funnier than a Spring Festival Gala sketch.

m-043.translation: I can't—your contact name is cracking me up, that's brutal.

m-048.translation: My blind date talked about her cat the whole time.

m-042.translation: Back in the day, I was riding high, playing my skill cards and raking in cash from every direction. Now look at me—reduced to shining shoes here.

errors.note: “一手技能牌”是比喻性的说法，指自己有一手好技能/本事，直译成“skill cards”会让英语观众误以为是字面上的卡牌，比喻义丢失。

errors.span: raking in cash from every direction
errors.note: “八方来财”是成语，译文意思基本对，但“from every direction”略显生硬，不够口语化。

m-046.translation: If you've got fleas, go take a bath. You've made my phone stink of them.

errors.span: You've made my phone stink of them.
errors.note: “把我手机整的骚哄的”是抱怨对方身上的跳蚤味把手机弄得难闻，译文说成对方让手机“发臭”，且“of them”指代跳蚤，意思有偏差。
“骚哄的”是口语化、略带粗俗的抱怨，译文“stink of them”较生硬，不够口语自然。

m-047.translation: I'm planning to start learning Python, but I have zero experience. Where's the best place to start?

m-050.translation: Remember, you don't need much equipment at the start—the key is to shoot a lot and practice a lot.

m-049.translation: As a new content creator, I've noticed my videos get decent views, but the comment section is always dead quiet.

m-051.translation: Quick, let me pinch myself to see if I'm dreaming.

m-053.translation: Work's been really stressful lately—I'm so anxious I can't sleep. Any tips to ease it?

m-052.translation: You're practically crying from panic—this place is colder than the Cold Palace.

errors.note: “你已急哭”是夸张/调侃的说法，意为“你急得都要哭了”，译成“practically crying from panic”把夸张语气坐实为真的在哭，语气和含义都有偏差。

errors.span: this place is colder than the Cold Palace
errors.note: “比冷宫还冷”是中文固定调侃，直译“colder than the Cold Palace”对英语观众生硬且“Cold Palace”未加解释，略显不自然。

m-058.translation: Post another update and I'll deal with you when I'm back in the country.

m-054.translation: If it's all about luck, why does gear even matter?

m-057.translation: My mom said she wants to set me up on a blind date.

errors.note: “家人们”是网络直播/短视频用语，指观众或粉丝群体，“Hey guys”偏普通口语，语气和网络感略有偏差，但不算误译。

m-055.translation: During a dorm contraband check, a condom dropped out from under my roommate's pillow.

errors.span: a condom dropped out from under my roommate's pillow
errors.note: 原文“掉出来个byt”未指明所属，译文用“my roommate's pillow”把视角限定为说话人舍友，属轻微增译/视角偏移，但整体意思基本一致。

m-059.translation: Seeing a video of a food delivery rider delivering in the rain

m-060.translation: The exam answers are right on page 50 of the textbook.

m-061.translation: What do I do, girls? I'm totally swooning over this move.

m-064.translation: I have my teacher certification interview next week. Is there anything I should pay special attention to in the demo lesson part?

m-063.translation: Help me cop the limited-edition sneakers.

m-066.translation: I can't understand a word of the English listening exam.

m-062.translation: My feed is nothing but people posting "666" — it's honestly driving me nuts.

m-065.translation: There's this guy in the next class who strikes a brooding pose in the mirror after class and claims he's the male lead of some drama.

m-068.translation: I can't take this anymore, ahhh! My brain is literally turning to mush listening to this.

errors.note: 原文没有“literally”的意思，属于增译，略微加强了语气。

m-067.translation: I can't—I'm dying laughing! This impression is so spot-on, it's literally a carbon copy of the original. 666, not even trying to hide it. This one's the ultimate drama queen.

errors.note: 中文网络用语“666”直译保留，英文观众难以理解，宜意译为“insane”或“next level”等。

m-069.translation: What does this Moments post my partner posted mean?

errors.span: this Moments post my partner posted
errors.note: “post”重复出现（post...posted），措辞冗余、不够自然，可改为“this Moments post from my partner”。

m-070.translation: I just dropped a meme I'd been saving for a whole year in the group chat, and it totally fell flat.

m-072.translation: I can't handle this, it's way too intense.

m-071.translation: You're literally crying from panic—reply now, reply now!

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张说法，指急得快要哭出来，并非真的在哭；“literally crying”把它误译成字面意义上的哭泣，改变了意思。
原文“马上回马上回”是急促重复的口语催促，译文用破折号连接并重复，语气偏生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-074.translation: Ideally somewhere that's great for taking photos and posting.

m-073.translation: Li Zongheng stars in a story about a father-in-law who loves to pull pranks, showing the Spring Festival fun of this generation of young people stepping up to take charge.

errors.note: “这届年轻人”是网络流行语，指当代年轻人，译为“this generation of young people”基本达意，但略失原文的调侃语气。
“主持大局”译为“stepping up to take charge”偏正式书面，作为字幕略显生硬，可用更口语化的表达。

m-076.translation: You'll need: 200g cake flour, 100g butter, 60g powdered sugar, and 1 egg.

m-075.translation: The meme "I want to check the cards" comes from a classic line in Stephen Chow's movie God of Gamblers in France.

errors.note: 片名错误：周星驰的《赌神》应为 God of Gamblers，而“法国赌神”是另一部片名/角色，译文把“法国”并入片名，误导观众。
原文“法国赌神”指片名/角色，译文将其处理为地点“在法国”，意思偏差。

errors.span: The meme "I want to check the cards"
errors.note: “验牌”译为 check the cards 偏生硬，字幕口语中可更自然，但不影响理解。

m-079.translation: So how's the new character from this gacha?

m-078.translation: I'm already halfway done—I've got 50 slides written—and now you're telling me I might have to scrap it all and start over?

m-082.translation: I actually stayed to watch the Spring Festival Gala—this show is amazing!

m-080.translation: There's another one that works too.

errors.note: 原文“可以可以”只是重复确认“可以/行”，并未表达“也能用/也行”的意思，译文增译了“works too”的含义。

m-084.translation: I recommend doing 20 targeted practice questions a day—you'll see progress in a month.

m-083.translation: I can't even—he's just too handsome!

m-081.translation: Has no one noticed how smart she is? She blew up by starting her account with absurd, meme-y content, then switched to a looks-based style—giving her fans a huge contrast.

errors.note: “抽象”在此网络语境指荒诞/无厘头风格，译成“absurd, meme-y”基本达意，但“meme-y”略增译，原文未明确提到梗/表情包。

errors.span: blew up by starting her account
errors.note: “起号”指开设/运营账号起步，译文“starting her account”稍显生硬，且“blew up by starting”逻辑略绕，可更口语化。

m-085.translation: She'll probably laugh when she sees this meme.

m-086.translation: My teammate's 0-10 and still bossing everyone around like crazy.

m-087.translation: I just finished a business plan. Take a look and tell me what you think.

m-088.translation: I've been wanting to start doing yoga at home lately, but I'm a total beginner and have no idea where to start.

m-089.translation: I'm begging you, hold it in — don't let the boss catch you.

m-090.translation: How to spot a cheater when playing cards

m-092.translation: What should I try next episode? Let me know in the comments!

m-094.translation: Hahaha I can't even, that description is way too funny.

m-095.translation: This joke is so funny it should be on national TV.

m-091.translation: Only something so abstract that no one can make sense of it is a real challenge.

errors.span: Only something so abstract that no one can make sense of it is a real challenge.
errors.note: 原文“抽象到让人看不懂的东西才叫挑战”是口语化断言，译文用“Only...is a real challenge”把“才叫”强化为排他性条件，且“so...that no one can make sense of it”把“让人看不懂”绝对化为“无人能懂”，语义有偏差。

errors.span: Only something so abstract that no one can make sense of it is a real challenge.
errors.note: 句式冗长书面，不像字幕口语，可更简洁自然。

m-093.translation: What's wrong with you? I can't take this anymore.

errors.note: “有病吧”在此是口语化的吐槽/感叹（类似“疯了吧/搞什么”），译成“What's wrong with you?”变成直接质问对方，语气和指向都偏了。
“我不行了”更接近“我受不了了/我撑不住了”，译文可接受，但“anymore”略增了“再也”的持续含义。

m-098.translation: Why are you so against internet slang?

m-097.translation: Can you solve this problem or not?

m-099.translation: Now you get what 'Workplace Nuannuan' means, right?

m-102.translation: Did you know that Guang Tou Qiang's voice actor is actually a top-tier singer?

errors.note: 角色名应使用官方英文名 "Logger Vick"，拼音译名会让英文观众无法识别该角色。

m-100.translation: I recommend downloading the Keep or Xunji app and following their free courses—it's safe and structured.

m-101.translation: This is the first time I've so clearly realized how bad my internet addiction is.

m-104.translation: What memes are Gen Z into these days?

m-103.translation: If it weren't for this crappy job trapping me every day, I'd buy a plane ticket right now and fly to Xi'an to settle scores with you!

errors.note: “算账”在此口语语境中意为找对方理论/发火，译成“settle scores”偏重“报复旧怨”，语气略有偏差。

m-105.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? I wasted ages trying to figure out the character relationships.

m-107.translation: I rushed down to give them a piece of my mind, but I got so worked up I bit my tongue—now it hurts so bad I'm in tears.

m-109.translation: Ha, it's fine—I'm watching that movie you mentioned during the New Year's Eve gala.

m-108.translation: I'm begging you, just leave our team alone.

m-110.translation: You can set up the basic system for under 2,000. Just remember to plan out your outlet locations and network coverage.

errors.note: 原文“预算2000内”未说明货币单位，译文直接写成“2,000”会让英文观众误以为是美元或其他货币，丢失了人民币语境。

m-112.translation: Are tutorials these days really this half-assed?

m-114.translation: My mom said if I don't find someone soon, I shouldn't bother coming home.

m-113.translation: I've hit a plateau in my grad school entrance exam prep. I'm anxious every day and can't focus on studying. How should I adjust my mindset and boost my efficiency?

m-115.translation: Keep your resume to one page with a clean layout, and make absolutely sure there are no typos.

m-116.translation: I ate the last piece of cake.

m-117.translation: Alright, once I'm back in the country, I'll officiate your wedding.

errors.note: “证婚”指作为证婚人见证婚礼，并非“officiate”（主持婚礼），语义有偏差。

m-119.translation: So unhinged—a full rundown of young people's mental state these days

m-118.translation: So you're watching the Spring Festival Gala, huh? Then let me just fast-forward you straight to New Year's Eve.

m-123.translation: When traveling with your parents, it's best to pick a relaxed city with convenient transportation and well-equipped facilities.

m-121.translation: I'm done. Is this kid insane or what?

m-122.translation: This is the first time I've seen such a luxurious villa.

m-120.translation: I've been wanting to learn how to bake bread lately, but I have zero experience. Where should I start?

m-124.translation: I stayed up too late last night, I'm so tired.

errors.span: I stayed up too late last night, I'm so tired.
errors.note: 两个独立分句用逗号连接，构成逗号粘连（run-on），应改为句号或加连词。

m-127.translation: I'm saying, why do you care so much about people saying "666"?

m-128.translation: The boss said our bonus is doubling this month.

m-130.translation: That metaphor is way too abstract, isn't it?

m-125.translation: This is Abstract Bro—not like B Bro, who's the quiet study type.

errors.note: “抽象哥”是网络绰号，直译为 Abstract Bro 生硬，不像字幕口语化昵称，可考虑意译或加引号处理。
“b哥”作为昵称直译成 B Bro 不自然，中文昵称的字母+哥结构在英文中缺乏对应，显得生硬。

m-126.translation: What's up with me suddenly bursting out laughing at an anatomy diagram?

m-132.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier? I'm running home to change right now.

m-129.translation: I'm begging you, hold it in—don't let them think you're a psycho.

m-131.translation: I can't even—hell must have frozen over.

errors.note: “我不行了”在此语境中表示受不了/吃不消，译成“I can't even—”偏向网络流行语的“无语”义，语义略有偏移，但大致可理解。

m-133.translation: For food, just head to the area around the wet market—cheap and authentic.

m-134.translation: My partner wants us to take a month-long break.

m-139.translation: Those shoes I just snagged are actually a pre-order.

m-136.translation: For larger spaces, a Mesh Wi-Fi system is the best option—it's pricier, but you get full coverage with no dead zones.

m-135.translation: So what? You got won over by her looks?

errors.span: You got won over by her looks?
errors.note: “got won over”略显生硬，口语中更自然说法是“got won over by her looks”可改为“fell for her looks”或“won over by her looks”，但不影响理解。

m-140.translation: Check out this dark joke I just learned.

m-138.translation: No dating for me—I just wanna chill at home and do nothing.

errors.note: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，译成“No dating for me”基本达意，但“处”在此语境更接近“处对象”，译文尚可接受；不过若严格看，“不处”也可能指“不相处/不处关系”，此处偏差不大，属可接受范围。

m-137.translation: The power of six wallets—a million in savings per person

m-141.translation: Please, I really wanna climb the ranks, please don't leave

m-142.translation: My mom's insisting I go on a blind date.

m-143.translation: This exam was so hard, I was completely lost.

m-148.translation: That's so random—it reminds me of my classmate in elementary school. She marveled at how pale I was and asked if I was white.

m-147.translation: But I think it's really sacred—that's the kind of thing you'd pass down as a family heirloom!

m-149.translation: My boss suddenly asked me to go abroad on a business trip.

m-144.translation: I recommend the figure reasoning volume of Huatu's Module Treasure Book series—the explanations are really systematic.

errors.note: “图形”在公考语境指图形推理（graphic/visual reasoning），译成 figure reasoning 不够规范，易被理解为“人物/数字推理”。
书名《华图模块宝典》宜按专有名词处理（如 Huatu Module Baodian），此处意译成 Module Treasure Book 不够统一、不够像书名。

m-146.translation: I can't hahaha, he's a genius

errors.note: “我不行了”是口语化的“我受不了了/笑死我了”，译成“I can't”意思不完整，观众可能误解为字面意义的“我不能”。
“他太有才了”是口语化的赞叹，译成“he's a genius”略偏正式、语义偏强，但基本可接受。

m-150.translation: My dad said back in the day, all it took to win my mom over was one meal.

m-145.translation: I don't think you've sobered up yet. A 996 corporate drone like me is better off doing the Ge You slouch at home—the delivery guy is my best buddy.

errors.note: 原文“996社畜就适合在家葛优躺”是泛指的评论（“996社畜”这类人就适合……），译文改成“像我这样的996社畜”，把泛指变成特指，并额外加入了原文没有的“like me”。
“葛优躺”译为“Ge You slouch”可以接受，但“doing the Ge You slouch”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然的是“Ge You-ing”或“doing the Ge You recline/lie-down”。
